issue_context.title: Entity properties which are Enums represented by `number` are returned as `string`
issue_context.body:

[x] `0.2.7`
[x] `0.2.8`

**Steps to reproduce or a small repository showing the problem:**

1. Define an Entity with an Enum property `prop`, represented as a number
2. Sync the database
3. Create an instance of the Entity and save it to the database
4. Fetch the Entity
5. Look at the `prop` type and observe it is a `string` rather than a `number`.

```ts
enum UserRole {
    USER = 1,
    ADMIN = 2
}

@Entity()
export class User {
  // ... other properties

  @Column("enum", { enum: UserRole })
  role: UserRole
}

const user = await dbConnection.manager.getRepository(User).findOne(userId);
console.log("user.role type:", typeof user.role, "; expected: number")
// output: user.role type: string ; expected: number
```
